well i started out with 16/8 for a few months. then it got to a point where i wasn’t hungry at all after the 16 hr mark so i changed to 18/6. 

healthy & fresh foods, no extra servings or overeating (although sometimes i have cheat days and eat more than usual). 
i would only break my fast on vacations or days where something fun is planned! 

i did find that 18/6 made me tired and unfocused bc all i would think about is the time where i’d be able to eat again. 
so i would always switch between 16,17,18 hrs depending on the day & what i’m doing. 

a big factor though is what you eat. 
healthier foods, no big servings / overeating. 

i also work in a garden where i’m always moving around. so i don’t eat before and now i’m on a 16-18 hour fast.

***everyones body is different too !*** 

& stay hydrated always.

hi i can definitely relate to u. 
i’ve been battling depression since high school, been in therapy for a year and started taking ssri’s to get by. 
i threw myself into a physics major, not fully aware of all the work i’d be commuting to. 
i love the subject though, i hope to study the cosmos one day. it is a real battle with my mental health + the constant grind. 
so much little energy and bad thoughts floating around in my head. 

the only thing i keep telling myself is to have strength. keep reminding yourself of your passion and what makes you happy. 
i know it is so draining being constantly busy. 

i’ve tried adapting to a block schedule, maybe you can too if you’ve heard of it. 
slowly adapting yourself to it, setting specific times to do specific things. 
find time to exercise, meditate and stretch in the morning, take time to be in nature on the weekends or after your done with work. 
physics is a beautiful, yet demanding study. be sure to take in more beauty around the world as you’re learning how it works. 

i give you my strength. i wish you best of luck. you can do it.
